thresholds.c_gate: 20/20 controls (10 validated anchors in_range, 10 plants out_of_range)
thresholds.unit_fail_rule: fails two of three checks a-c (n/a counts neither way); d and memory consistency are reported, never part of the verdict

d_reference_agreement.rule: a rendering's target agrees with the reference when at least one normalised content token of the rendering occurs in the normalised reference passage (score_consistency.norm on both: lower-case, stop words, singularisation, synonym fold); only targets whose Greek token falls inside the passage's lines count; lenient by construction (passage-level), so the number is a floor on disagreement, not a ceiling
